behavior_evidence.interpretation_limit: Observed direction and entropy do NOT establish negative curvature or a causal next-item improvement.

behavior_problem_candidates.candidate: Session-conditioned next-item prediction using generative Semantic IDs, with hyperbolic geometry as a proposed representation/regularization choice.
behavior_problem_candidates.research_gap: A direct three-way intersection is not verified; do not represent hyperbolic geometry as part of TIGER or as an established combined method.
behavior_problem_candidates.supported_overlap: The TIGER abstract directly supports session-based next-item prediction and generative Semantic IDs.
behavior_problem_candidates.unsupported_overlap: No independently verified source in this evidence set establishes that the same method uses hyperbolic geometry.

limitations: No source was independently verified here that combines all three elements: user next-item behavior, hyperbolic geometry, and generative Semantic IDs.
The only included paper is verified from its arXiv abstract page; despite the linked HTML/PDF, no claim from its full text is labeled FULL_TEXT.
The absence of a verified combined paper in this small evidence set is not proof that none exists.
No prior-candidate prompt or unseen future/test interaction was used.

manifest.research_question: Research verified literature where user next-item behavior, hyperbolic geometry and generative semantic IDs intersect.

sources.evidence_basis: ArXiv landing page abstract explicitly says that the model takes Semantic IDs for items in a user session and predicts the Semantic ID of the next item the user will interact with. The landing page provides full-text links, but the full text itself was not inspected for this report.

exact_overlap.generative_semantic_ids: Direct: autoregressive generative retrieval decodes semantically meaningful codeword tuples (Semantic IDs).
exact_overlap.hyperbolic_geometry: Not evidenced in the checked abstract.
exact_overlap.user_next_item_behavior: Direct: next-item prediction from a user session.

sources.title: Recommender Systems with Generative Retrieval
